description: Global config for the self-hosted Renovate run (the sdlc fleet ci.yml renovate job).
Every crunchtools/* repo inherits renovate/org-inherited-config.json from this
repo's default branch, which turns off onboarding, makes a repo config optional
and extends renovate/default.json at v1. Forks are processed: a forked MCP server
is ours to keep current. The workflow sets dryRun unless a real run was asked for.
